name: Remove group
description: Remove group Permanently deletes a group. DELETE /2.0/groups/{group_id}

name: List groups for enterprise
description: List groups for enterprise Retrieves all of the groups for a given enterprise. GET /2.0/groups
context:
GET /2.0/groups
Retrieves all of the groups for a given enterprise. The user must have admin permissions to inspect enterprise's groups.
Optional: filter_term (query) — Limits the results to only groups whose `name` starts with the search term.; fields (query) — A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.; offset (query) — The offset of the item at which to begin the response. Queries with offset parameter value exceeding 10000 will be rejected with a 400 response.

name: Get group
description: Get group Retrieves information about a group. GET /2.0/groups/{group_id}
context:
GET /2.0/groups/{group_id}
Retrieves information about a group. Only members of this group or users with admin-level permissions will be able to use this API.
Required: group_id (path) — The ID of the group.
Optional: fields (query) — A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested.

name: List group collaborations
description: List group collaborations Retrieves all the collaborations for a group. GET /2.0/groups/{group_id}/collaborations
context:
GET /2.0/groups/{group_id}/collaborations
Retrieves all the collaborations for a group. The user must have admin permissions to inspect enterprise's groups. Each collaboration object has details on which files or folders the group has access to and with what role.
Required: group_id (path) — The ID of the group.
Optional: limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.; offset (query) — The offset of the item at which to begin the response. Queries with offset parameter value exceeding 10000 will be rejected with a 400 response.

name: Create jobs to terminate user group session
description: Create jobs to terminate user group session Validates the roles and permissions of the group, and creates asynchronous jobs to terminate the group's sessions. POST /2.0/groups/terminate_sessions
context:
POST /2.0/groups/terminate_sessions
Validates the roles and permissions of the group, and creates asynchronous jobs to terminate the group's sessions. Returns the status for the POST request.
